questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.learningObjective: Choose the correct copula for a permanent trait

stimulus.body: En una nota de trabajo sobre este punto se lee: « El sistema ___ estable » La nota ofrece cuatro afirmaciones posibles; solo una se desprende de lo que el texto dice realmente.

questions.stem: La nota anterior aporta datos para juzgar esta forma. ¿Cuál de las cuatro opciones está realmente respaldada por el texto, y por qué las demás no?

options.text: es, because the report describes an essential characteristic of the product
está, because the system could change its stability after the next update
options.misconception: treats an inherent property as a temporary state

options.text: es, because stability is treated as a permanent inherent property of the system
options.misconception: treats a temporary state as a permanent trait

options.text: está, because the report was written on a specific day
options.misconception: confuses date of writing with nature of the trait

questions.explanation: Ser marks an inherent characteristic, while estar marks a temporary state or location. The report describes stability as an essential feature, so ser is correct. The tempting estar option confuses a fixed property with a passing condition.
questions.hint: Ask whether the trait is inherent or temporary.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.learningObjective: Apply the stem change in a workplace context

stimulus.body: El fragmento siguiente sirve para comprobar la comprensión de esta forma. « El supervisor pide más datos » Cuatro opciones responden a él, y una sola concuerda con los datos de la nota.

questions.stem: Al revisar las afirmaciones sobre esta forma que propone el fragmento anterior, ¿qué respuesta se desprende únicamente de los datos de la nota?

answer.exemplar: The verb pedir is a stem-changing verb of the e to i type, so the stem vowel changes in most present forms but not in nosotros and vosotros. In the third person singular the form is pide, not pede, because the e becomes i. This keeps the report grammatically standard and avoids a nonexistent form.

questions.explanation: Stem-changing verbs alter the stem vowel in most present tense forms. For pedir the e becomes i in the third person singular, yielding pide. Writing pede ignores the documented stem change and is not a valid form.
questions.hint: Identify the stem change type for pedir.

options.misconception: borrows a different spelling change pattern

questions.hint: Check the verb's own spelling rule, not a generic stem change.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.learningObjective: Build a gustar-type sentence in a report

Los empleados gustan la política, with employees as subject

options.text: La política gustan los empleados, with plural agreement on the verb
options.misconception: agrees the verb with the indirect object

options.text: Los empleados se gustan la política, adding an unnecessary reflexive

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: with gustar-type verbs the thing liked is the subject and the person is the indirect object. On that basis "La política gusta a los empleados, with the policy as subject" is the supported choice. Option B ("Los empleados gustan la política, with employees as subject") fails because it treats gustar like a regular transitive verb; Option C ("La política gustan los empleados, with plural agreement on the…") fails because it agrees the verb with the indirect object; Option D ("Los empleados se gustan la política, adding an unnecessary…") fails because it invents a reflexive construction.

questions.topic: Ser and estar with a participle

questions.stem: Al revisar las afirmaciones sobre esta forma que propone el fragmento anterior, ¿qué respuesta se desprende únicamente de los datos de la nota?

answer.exemplar: Estar plus participle describes a resulting state, so 'está firmado' means the report is already signed. Ser plus participle would describe an action being performed, which is not the intended meaning here. The report focuses on the current state of the document, not the act of signing.

questions.explanation: Estar with a participle expresses a resulting state, while ser with a participle can express a passive action. The report describes the document's state, so estar is the natural choice. Ser would shift the focus to the action.
questions.hint: Decide whether you describe a state or an action.

answer.exemplar: Estar plus participle describes the resulting state of the contract, which is already signed. Ser plus participle would focus on the signing action itself. The report describes the document's current condition, so estar is the natural choice.

questions.topic: Ser and estar with a participle
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish ser plus participle from estar plus participle

stimulus.body: En una nota de trabajo sobre este punto se lee: « El informe es terminado » La nota ofrece cuatro afirmaciones posibles; solo una se desprende de lo que el texto dice realmente.

questions.stem: La nota anterior aporta datos para juzgar esta forma. ¿Cuál de las cuatro opciones está realmente respaldada por el texto, y por qué las demás no?

answer.exemplar: Estar plus participle describes a resulting state, so 'está terminado' means the report is already finished. Ser plus participle would describe an action being performed, which is not the intended meaning here. The report focuses on the current state of the document.

questions.explanation: Estar with a participle expresses a resulting state, while ser with a participle can express a passive action. The report describes the document's state, so estar is the natural choice. Ser would shift the focus to the action.
questions.hint: Decide whether you describe a state or an action.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.learningObjective: Choose preterite or imperfect in a report

stimulus.body: El fragmento siguiente sirve para comprobar la comprensión de esta forma. « encontró » Cuatro opciones responden a él, y una sola concuerda con los datos de la nota.

questions.stem: Al revisar las afirmaciones sobre esta forma que propone el fragmento anterior, ¿qué respuesta se desprende únicamente de los datos de la nota?

options.text: Because finding sets the scene for the waiting
options.misconception: confuses completed event with background scene

options.text: Because finding the error is a completed event
Because encontrar is always preterite
options.misconception: substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for the relation the passage establishes

options.text: Because the sentence has no time marker
options.misconception: relies on surface form instead of aspect

questions.explanation: The preterite marks a completed event with a clear endpoint. Finding the error is a completed action, so preterite is appropriate. The other options misread the aspect or invent fixed rules.
questions.hint: Ask whether the action completes a plot point.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.learningObjective: Use preterite of ir in a report

stimulus.body: En una nota de trabajo sobre este punto se lee: « El director ___ a la oficina ayer » La nota ofrece cuatro afirmaciones posibles; solo una se desprende de lo que el texto dice realmente.

questions.stem: La nota anterior aporta datos para juzgar esta forma. ¿Cuál de las cuatro opciones está realmente respaldada por el texto, y por qué las demás no?

options.text: va, the present third singular
iba, the imperfect third singular
fue, the preterite third singular
irá, the future third singular

questions.explanation: The preterite of ir in the third singular is fue. The other options belong to different tenses and do not match the completed past action described in the report.
questions.hint: Select the completed past form.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.learningObjective: Form the simple future in a report

stimulus.body: El fragmento siguiente sirve para comprobar la comprensión de esta forma. « the director will sign the contract » Cuatro opciones responden a él, y una sola concuerda con los datos de la nota.

questions.stem: Al revisar las afirmaciones sobre esta forma que propone el fragmento anterior, ¿qué respuesta se desprende únicamente de los datos de la nota?

options.text: firmaría, conditional third singular
firmaba, imperfect third singular
ha firmado, present perfect third singular
options.misconception: uses present perfect instead of future

options.text: firmará, simple future third singular

questions.explanation: The simple future of firmar in the third singular is firmará. It expresses a future action. The other options are different tenses and do not convey that future meaning.
questions.hint: Match 'will sign' to the future tense.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.learningObjective: Express a planned action with near future

stimulus.body: En una nota de trabajo sobre este punto se lee: « Vamos a revisar los datos mañana » La nota ofrece cuatro afirmaciones posibles; solo una se desprende de lo que el texto dice realmente.

questions.stem: La nota anterior aporta datos para juzgar esta forma. ¿Cuál de las cuatro opciones está realmente respaldada por el texto, y por qué las demás no?

answer.exemplar: The construction ir a plus infinitive expresses a planned or imminent action. Since the review happens tomorrow, the near future conveys intention and proximity better than the simple future. Both are grammatical, but the near future fits the planned tone.

questions.explanation: Ir a plus infinitive highlights a planned or imminent action. The report's mention of tomorrow supports that reading. The simple future would be acceptable but less immediate in tone.
questions.hint: Consider immediacy and intention.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.learningObjective: Choose por or para in a report

stimulus.body: El fragmento siguiente sirve para comprobar la comprensión de esta forma. « por correo » Cuatro opciones responden a él, y una sola concuerda con los datos de la nota.

questions.stem: Al revisar las afirmaciones sobre esta forma que propone el fragmento anterior, ¿qué respuesta se desprende únicamente de los datos de la nota?

options.text: Recipient, because correo receives the report
Means or method, because correo is the delivery method
Cause, because the mail caused the delivery
Duration, because the mail takes time

questions.explanation: Por marks the means or method of delivery. The report was sent by mail, so por correo is correct. The other options describe different uses not present in that phrase.
questions.hint: Ask how the report was delivered.

questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.learningObjective: Identify the direct object in a report

stimulus.body: El fragmento siguiente sirve para comprobar la comprensión de esta forma. « La gerente envió el informe a los clientes » Cuatro opciones responden a él, y una sola concuerda con los datos de la nota.

questions.stem: Al revisar las afirmaciones sobre esta forma que propone el fragmento anterior, ¿qué respuesta se desprende únicamente de los datos de la nota?

options.text: La gerente, because she performs the sending
a los clientes, because they receive the sending
options.misconception: confuses indirect object with direct object

options.text: el informe, because it is the thing sent
envió, because it is the action verb

questions.explanation: The direct object is the thing acted upon, the report. El informe is the direct object. A los clientes is the indirect object, the recipient.
questions.hint: Find what is sent.
